overview_description.description:
Swan is a European fintech and innovation leader in embedded finance. Swan’s Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS) is the easiest way for companies to embed banking features. Via Swan’s simple APIs, European companies can integrate banking services (accounts, cards, and payments) quickly and easily into their own product.

Founded in 2019, the fintech processes over 200 million euros of transactions per month, for 60+ companies across ten European countries. Swan has over 100 employees and is led by fintech experts and experienced entrepreneurs: Nicolas Benady, Nicolas Saison and Mathieu Breton. The company was founded together with the startup studio eFounders and has received growth capital from leading VC investors such as Creandum and Accel. Swan is a Mastercard principal member and a licensed financial institution, regulated by the ACPR.

about_short_description.short_description: Swan is a banking service platform that enables businesses to integrate embedded finance platform that integrates banking services.

product.name: Business Accounts
product.description: API-driven business accounts embedded in software products, enabling users to hold funds, manage balances, and access integrated cards and payment services.

product.name: Card Programs
product.description: A card-issuing platform for launching branded physical, virtual, and single-use Mastercard cards with programmable spending controls and transaction monitoring.

product.name: Send Payments
product.description: Embedded payment infrastructure for SEPA, international, card, and recurring transfers, with batch processing, automation, and transaction reconciliation inside a platform.

product.name: Local Accounts
product.description: Business accounts with locally issued IBANs in France, Germany, Spain, Italy, Belgium, and the Netherlands, supporting domestic account behavior and local compliance.

product.name: Accept Payments
product.description: An embedded payment acceptance service for collecting transfers, online and in-person card payments, direct debits, payment links, and French checks into a Swan account.

product.name: Expense Cards
product.description: Branded physical and virtual cards for employee spending, one-off vendor purchases, and subscriptions, with programmable limits, merchant controls, alerts, and real-time analytics.
